# sonarqube_rules (Data Source)

Use this data source to list Sonarqube rules matching a set of filters, for example to activate them on a quality profile with `for_each`. All filters are optional and combine with AND; values within one filter combine with OR. SonarQube returns at most 10000 rules for one search, so use filters to narrow large rule sets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_rules" "critical_code_smells" {
  languages  = ["java"]
  types      = ["CODE_SMELL"]
  severities = ["CRITICAL"]
  statuses   = ["READY"]
}

resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "java" {
  name     = "Java strict"
  language = "java"
}

resource "sonarqube_qualityprofile_activate_rule" "critical_code_smells" {
  for_each = { for rule in data.sonarqube_rules.critical_code_smells.rules : rule.key => rule }
  key      = sonarqube_qualityprofile.java.key
  rule     = each.key
  severity = each.value.severity
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `languages` (Set of String) Language keys, e.g. `java`, `cs`, `js`.
- `repositories` (Set of String) Rule repository keys, e.g. `java`, `csharpsquid`.
- `search` (String) Free-text search, the same as the search box on the SonarQube rules page.
- `severities` (Set of String) Severities: `INFO`, `MINOR`, `MAJOR`, `CRITICAL`, `BLOCKER`.
- `statuses` (Set of String) Statuses: `READY`, `BETA`, `DEPRECATED`, `REMOVED`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Rule tags.
- `types` (Set of String) Types: `CODE_SMELL`, `BUG`, `VULNERABILITY`, `SECURITY_HOTSPOT`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rules` (List of Object) The rules matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
